This is the specialist-commentary layer of the cell: bank executives, BSI staff and academics publish payment-system and card-business analysis here, often with numbers before or beyond the news cycle.

negative_findings.description: No source matching the brief's 'Bankazaveznik-type fintech commentary' could be located. Searches in Slovene for a dedicated fintech/payments commentary blog returned no independent Slovene-language specialist fintech blog with a stable domain.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovene fintech commentary appears to be distributed across general business media (Forbes Slovenija, Svet kapitala, Finance.si), consumer-tech sites (Računalniške novice) and the ZBS journal, rather than concentrated in a standalone blog. 'Bankazaveznik' returned nothing identifiable and may be a garbled or non-existent name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell assumed a specialist independent commentary layer exists; if it does not, that intelligence must be sourced from association journals and forums instead, changing collection design.

negative_findings.description: Finance.si, the single most important business title for this cell, returned almost no full-text content through search — consistent with a hard subscription wall.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results for Slovene card-business and fee queries surfaced Croatian and Bosnian outlets instead of Finance.si articles, suggesting Finance.si content is not indexed in full.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest fee and market-share reporting is likely invisible to any unlicensed collection pipeline; a subscription is probably a hard requirement rather than an optimisation.

negative_findings.description: The Slovene term 'kartično poslovanje' is heavily dominated by Croatian and Bosnian sources because the phrase is near-identical across BCS languages.
negative_findings.result_summary: The seed query returned jatrgovac.com (HR), klix.ba (BA), banksoft.eu (HR) and a Split repository thesis, and zero Slovenian hits.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated Slovene-language collection must constrain by domain (.si) or add Slovenia-specific anchors (Banka Slovenije, NLB, Flik, bankomat), or it will silently ingest Croatian market data as Slovenian.

negative_findings.description: The Dnevnik.si business-section URL path was inferred rather than confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dnevnik did not appear in the result sets for the cash/ATM seed query despite being named in the cell scope; only the root domain is asserted with confidence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection job pointed at an unverified section path would fail silently; the path must be confirmed on first crawl.

negative_findings.description: Bančni vestnik full text sits behind a login ('Prijava') at bv.zbs-giz.si.
negative_findings.result_summary: Result titles for the journal archive read as login and legal-notice pages; the public ZBS site carries only issue announcements and an English 'About' page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-quality specialist analysis layer is subscription-gated — this is a budget/licensing decision, not a technical blocker, and the journal should not be recorded as inaccessible.

coverage_gaps.description: No Slovene-language podcast, newsletter or video-commentary source was identified for banking and payments, though such formats increasingly carry off-record executive commentary.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted searches for 'podkast bančništvo Slovenija', 'newsletter finance Slovenija', and check Finance.si / Svet kapitala / Forbes Slovenija for podcast verticals; also check YouTube channels of the major outlets.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical media archive route was established for reconstructing fee or ATM-network changes before roughly 2015; paywalled dailies do not expose deep archives publicly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate the Digital Library of Slovenia (dLib.si) and COBISS for digitised runs of Finance, Delo and Bančni vestnik, and check whether Slovenian outlets are covered by any press-archive aggregator.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language commentary specifically on the Slovenian payments market is thin and mostly from non-Slovene vendors (The Fintech Times, GlobalData, TheBanks.eu, sloveniabusiness.eu), which lag and simplify the Slovene reporting.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do not rely on English sources for this cell beyond STA English and the November English issue of Bančni vestnik; treat English vendor reports as leads to be re-verified in Slovene.

coverage_gaps.description: Merchant- and acquirer-side media commentary (retail trade press, hospitality associations complaining about POS acceptance costs) was not covered by this cell's searches.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search Slovene trade press for 'trgovci provizije kartično plačilo', 'Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije plačilne kartice', and the hospitality sector, to capture the merchant view of interchange and POS fees.

coverage_gaps.description: All URLs in this slice are search-derived; none were fetched and none should be treated as liveness-verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass; treat 403/timeout as bot-defence (likely live) and only 404/NXDOMAIN as evidence of a moved or dead source.

brief: Slovenia's banking and payments media landscape is small, concentrated and overwhelmingly Slovene-language: three tiers matter — the paywalled business press (Finance.si, Delo/Svet kapitala, Forbes Slovenija) which carries fee, market-share and profitability detail; the free public-interest layer (RTVSLO, STA wire and its republishers Siol.net and N1) which is the reliable, archivable record of Banka Slovenije statements, instant-payments/Flik developments, ATM-density legislation and cash-access policy; and a specialist/indirect layer (Bančni vestnik from the bank association, ZPS consumer tests, Cekin.si comparison hubs, Slo-Tech forum threads) that generates or first surfaces the numbers the press later amplifies. The most operationally valuable non-obvious finds are Necenzurirano.si for payment-outage and core-system-failure investigations, entity tag pages across delo.si/siol.net/cekin.si as durable free pointer feeds behind the paywalls, and Bančni vestnik as the only sustained specialist analysis venue including an annual English issue. Two structural cautions: 'kartično poslovanje' and similar Slovene terms collide with Croatian/Bosnian coverage and must be domain- or actor-anchored, and no standalone Slovene fintech commentary blog of the type the cell brief anticipated could be found — that function is dispersed across the outlets above.
